items.english: From that day Tatsuya's comings and goings at the Miyoshi house came with no more pause than waves breaking on the shore. Between him and Zenpei it was quite as if they were kin. Everyone indoors knew that he was the weighty man in this affair, and with Zenpei to lead them not one of them thought to treat him slightingly. Tatsuya cast his spider's thread as he pleased and gathered them all into his net. So from the lowliest maid to the retired elder above he became the intimate among intimates, until the Miyoshi house and Tatsuya were no longer to be parted. Standing in the midst of it, Mitsuyo alone nursed her anger. Tatsuya grew more distasteful the more she looked at him, she knew not why, and her father who drew so close to him was hateful, her mother who kept no distance was mortifying, her easy elder sister was hateful, her smiling elder brother she could have bitten, and on every side nothing pleased her, on every side nothing pleased her, until at last in the fret that boiled over in her, the workaday maid who bore the brunt of it stood at a loss, tearful and wondering what to do, a strange picture of the world. Mitsuyo waited for Tsunao with a single heart. Knowing nothing of her feeling, Tsunao still did not come home. Alone and melancholy Mitsuyo gazed at the clouds of morning and evening. Her breast, bound to a destination she could not fix, grew ever more painful, and wondering where he might now be and what doing, the mirror she faced showed a worn face, and even that was soon clouded with a sigh.
notes: Took 上の隠居 as the retired senior of the house, set against 末の婢, rather than a named parent; the sense is from the lowest servant to the highest idler.
Kept the doubled 面白くなくて面白くなくて as a plain repetition, and the mirror clouded by a sigh as written, without explaining the sigh.

data.say: Drafted p96 keeping the spider thread and Mitsuyo's fretful catalogue intact.
